name: luban-cnc
description: Drive a Snapmaker A350 CNC through the Luban MCP server: motion rules, touch probing, camera alignment, tool changes, thread milling and accelerometer diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Operator-gated CNC control of a Snapmaker through Luban MCP
interface.longDescription: Connects to the MCP server built into this Luban fork (http://127.0.0.1:40889/mcp, enabled under Settings > MCP Server in the running app) and bundles the CNC skills that go with it. Load cnc-motion-rules before any motion; cnc-probing, cnc-visual-alignment, tool-change, cnc-thread-milling and cnc-vibration build on it. Every motion is staged for the operator to confirm in Luban. Never leave the machine unattended while it runs.
defaultPrompt: Check the CNC connection and position.
Plan a probe of the stock's top surface.
Change the tool and keep the work origin.
